none: PAS NLM-F1AC73: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTI] NOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow with shield right. In exergue: TRP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.0mm, Weight: 1.89gms, die axis: 6
